meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你从 cmem.ai Connect 拿到的凭据(sync token、user id、SyncHub URL)写进 claude-mem-cowork 插件的 config.json,让 hooks 能捕获并注入记忆,再跑状态命令回报打码结果。
howto.when: 当你要求设置或配对 claude-mem、连接 cmem,或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的同步令牌、user id 等值时触发。

say.note: 写入插件凭据后跑状态命令回报打码结果

say.text: 在 Cowork 里给这个插件配好 cloud sync
say.note: 会告知容器是临时的,要持久需重新打包

howto.what_en: Claude writes the credentials from cmem.ai Connect (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the claude-mem-cowork plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory, then runs a status check and reports masked output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, connect cmem, add your cmem key, or when you provide cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem — here are my cmem Connect values.
say_en.note: Writes plugin credentials, then reports masked status.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync in Cowork for this plugin.
say_en.note: Notes the container is ephemeral; repackage to persist.

say_en.text: Also write the same cloud sync values to ~/.claude-mem/settings.json.
